scope_note: SG-MA-PRODUCT-SELECTION after corrections following the V10H audit. The section now teaches that 105 CMR 721.020(A), (B) and (F), read with 721.003 and 721.010, set the format for showing "no substitution" (not the default, the interchange statement present, an indication the signature does not satisfy), and that under 721.040(A) a prescription in a nonconforming format is invalid and shall not be filled; neither text says what the pharmacist does next, so the section gives the safe course of dispensing nothing on it and obtaining a conforming prescription. On a conforming prescription where the element was not used, interchange under M.G.L. c. 112, s. 12D is still required. Interchangeability is now taught as chiefly a question of listing plus the rule in the introduction to the 105 CMR 720.200 appendix that products made under the brand's application may be interchanged, and Circular Letter DCP 22-01-112 (guidance) on authorized generics; both texts permit rather than require. A dated warning names Department texts that still describe interchange differently from the current statute (105 CMR 720.010, the appendix foreword and introduction, the commission size under M.G.L. c. 17, s. 13(a), and Department pages that omit the abuse-deterrent first step). New rules: MA-RX-NO-SUBSTITUTION-FORMAT-INVALID, MA-MLID-SAME-NDA-INTERCHANGE, MA-MLID-REGULATION-OLDER-DESCRIPTIONS, MA-AUTHORIZED-GENERIC-INTERCHANGE and MA-DCP-INTERCHANGE-SUMMARY-STATEMENTS. Scope gate: every actionable signal declined. MA-RX-FORMAT-CONTENT (prescription contents generally) and MA-PRESCRIPTION-LOCKBOX (planned for SG-MA-OUTSIDE-COUNTER-SUPPLY) are outside the declared scope; MA-BIOLOGIC-SUBSTITUTION is the record this section replaced; MA-EPT-EPRESCRIBING-EXCEPTION and MA-FAMILY-PLANNING-MEDICATION-ACCESS are neighbours taught in SG-MA-CONTRACEPTION-AND-EPT. All five practice links stay.
